scope: Conditional response identifiability on existing selected Pantheon or D03 cached arrays
required_existing_inputs: D03 selected original row indices, source directions, redshifts, magnitude or declared difference response
D03 original public full-Pantheon covariance subblock and covariance identity
D03 released survey, calibrator, host/group and method design keys
Existing D07 nuisance/gauge evidence for reuse, if the selected response uses D03 differences

analysis_branches.observation_law: m | fixed selected sky/redshift, baseline, d,a,gamma ~ Normal(m0 + X d + U a + Z gamma, C_public)
analysis_branches.flow_columns: U_i,kj = K_i B_k(r_i) n_ij; K follows CONDITIONAL_MODEL.md with radial gradient retained or a separately declared frozen-flow approximation
analysis_branches.nuisance_columns: Z retains applicable original nuisance columns and declared rank-deficient gauge treatment
analysis_branches.operation: Inspect whitened calibration columns after quotienting the span of [U,Z]; report rank, singular values and null directions
analysis_branches.covariance_accounting: C_public enters once as total released covariance; no second stochastic PV component or latent-PV convolution is added
analysis_branches.output_claim: Conditional identified response subspace for declared mean/covariance and selected rows

analysis_branches.missing_input: Source-qualified PV-removed Pantheon covariance or justified joint decomposition; paper uses privately supplied matrix
analysis_branches.action: Do not subtract an ad hoc PV term from the public covariance

source_qualification.kernel: Forward-model conditional, not complete relativistic luminosity-distance Doppler response
source_qualification.HI_parent: No complete 5460 inspection selection list acquired
source_qualification.contributors: Six-row source-claimed excerpt only; full export still absent

validation_before_interpretation: Check existing row and covariance identity; reject reordered or unmatched blocks
Record chosen baseline, radial basis, frame and units
Retain source-flow gradients or explicitly declare the frozen-flow branch
Reject singular deterministic inversion; use latent-distance formulation when needed
Distinguish proof/conditional rank result from physical or statistical calibration
